claims.statement: Figma's SCIM documentation describes an API token generated for the SCIM API (a different base URL and authentication method from the REST API), shown only once at generation, and sent in an Authorization header using Bearer.

sources.supports: Copy the API Token value. Note: This will only be shown once ... The API token must be included in an Authorization header using Bearer when calling any of the SCIM methods.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
